title: Desktop Settings -> Mouse Actions -> Vertical Scroll allows you to configure it to trigger actions that aren't triggerable by scrolling
line: Scroll triggers in Mouse Actions now only offer actions that work with scrolling (Switch Desktop, Window or Activity).
explanation: A scroll trigger only calls performNextAction/performPreviousAction on its containment action, which only the Switch Desktop, Switch Window and Switch Activity plugins implement. The Mouse Actions page still offered every plugin for scroll rows, and Add Action created new scroll rows with Standard Menu, so many configurations silently did nothing. The switch plugins now carry X-Plasma-SupportsWheel in their metadata, exposed by ContainmentConfigView as wheelContainmentActions; the page lists only those for Vertical/Horizontal-Scroll rows and turns a scroll trigger assigned to any other action into Switch Desktop.

commits.message:
containmentactions: mark the actions that can be triggered by scrolling

Scrolling only calls performNextAction and performPreviousAction, which
the menu, launcher and paste actions don't implement. Mark the switch
actions with X-Plasma-SupportsWheel and expose them to the config page.

BUG: 357367

desktoppackage/configuration: only offer scroll-capable mouse actions

Scroll triggers could be set to actions like Standard Menu or Application
Launcher, which do nothing on scroll. Scroll rows now only list actions
that support it, and new scroll triggers default to Switch Desktop.

BUG: 357367

+QStringList ContainmentConfigView::wheelContainmentActions() const
+{
+    QStringList actions;
+    const QList<KPluginMetaData> plugins = Plasma::PluginLoader::self()->listContainmentActionsMetaData(QString());
+    for (const KPluginMetaData &plugin : plugins) {
+        if (plugin.value(u"X-Plasma-SupportsWheel", false)) {
+            actions << plugin.pluginId();
+        }
+    }
+    return actions;
+}

media.caption: Add Action + scroll creates a Vertical-Scroll row set to Standard Menu
Its list offers Paste, Application Launcher and Standard Menu, which do nothing on scroll
With the fix the new Vertical-Scroll row starts on Switch Desktop
Its list only has the actions that work with scrolling
